reproduction_method: fetch exact source commit if absent from shallow checkout
create detached isolated worktree at exact source commit
execute the observer and source-bound rule pack from that exact worktree
run two clean observer builds and require identical topology SHA-256
require exact historical topology SHA-256 and exact 569 WARNING members
sort members by anomaly_id and hash each complete canonical anomaly payload
derive one membership SHA-256 from the ordered payload-hash vector
fresh_census_method: execute the same exact observer independently at the pre-GRT2 materialisation baseline
never redefine B0 from the fresh census
classify matching anomaly IDs as B0_MAPPED
classify non-B0 warnings already present on the pre-GRT2 baseline as LATE_DISCOVERED_PRE_EXISTING
classify absent B0 IDs as RESOLVED_BEFORE_GRT2
reserve TRANSITION_OR_NEW_DEBT for findings first observed after the pre-GRT2 baseline
gate_rule: GRT2-G1 BLOCK with B0_SOURCE_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE if source commit/tree/topology hash, 569 raw WARNING count, member uniqueness, or deterministic rebuild proof does not match exactly.
